tailoring.headline: Product Manager – eCommerce | SAP Commerce Cloud Expert | Techno-Functional Leader
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs and end-to-end PIM-ERP-MDM integrations. Proven track record translating business requirements into functional specifications, shaping product roadmaps, and guiding cross-functional teams through agile delivery. Skilled in stakeholder management, data-driven decision making, and AI-assisted development. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with strong B2B commerce experience.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Product Manager – eCommerce
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Materialise’s mission to make additive manufacturing smarter through connected digital workflows. With over five years designing and delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have built the e-commerce foundations that enable seamless B2B customer journeys.

bullets.label: Roadmap & Vision
bullets.text: At Rockwell I defined product roadmaps for API migrations and data-pipeline enhancements, aligning technical delivery with business goals and stakeholder priorities.

bullets.label: Requirement Translation
bullets.text: I worked in a techno-functional role translating business requirements into detailed user stories, functional specs, and OCC REST services that powered headless commerce experiences.

bullets.label: Stakeholder Collaboration
bullets.text: I partnered with international business and IT teams to resolve integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee, ensuring data consistency across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Data-Driven Delivery
bullets.text: Using CI/CD pipelines and AI-assisted analysis, I continuously measured performance, optimized queries, and delivered incremental improvements to the digital commerce platform.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Materialise’s e-commerce vision.

tailoring.why_company: Materialise’s focus on turning additive manufacturing into a fully digital, data-driven process aligns perfectly with my passion for bridging commerce and technology. I admire how your software connects customers to 3D printing services at scale, and I want to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to enhance the digital buying experience, drive conversion, and support the company’s vision of smarter manufacturing workflows.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help Materialise deliver seamless, data-driven e-commerce experiences that accelerate adoption of additive manufacturing, leveraging my SAP Commerce Cloud and B2B expertise.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of B2B e-commerce experience. I’m eager to discuss the Product Manager – eCommerce role at Materialise and how I can drive digital product success for your team.
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Product Manager – eCommerce role at Materialise. With 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep B2B e-commerce expertise, stakeholder management and data-driven product delivery. I am eager to help shape Materialise’s digital customer experience. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit.
